name: Transcription factor activity estimation benchmark
description: A benchmark and integrated resource set for evaluating methods that estimate human transcription factor activities from genomic and transcriptomic data.
evaluation_method: Spearman/Pearson correlation (primary) and sometimes AUPR/ROC for classification-style tasks
reputation: Well-regarded within computational biology and regulatory genomics as a resource for comparing transcription factor activity estimation methods.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; heterogeneous experimental conditions and batch effects across datasets, limited samples for some TFs, and results are sensitive to preprocessing and choice of reference/regulatory networks.
